description: This file defines a React-Redux connected component for listing direct message and group channels, including selector functions for filtering and sorting channels and users based on activity, search terms, and user status.

methods.name: makeGetOptions
methods.description: Creates a selector function to retrieve and filter options for direct message and group channels based on recent activity, search term, and selected users.

methods.name: makeMapStateToProps
methods.description: Creates a function to map Redux state to component props, specifically generating options for the List component.
